description.value: Babylon Cafe is a Middle Eastern fast-food restaurant on Commercial Drive serving shawerma, falafel, kebabs, and wraps with house-made sauces and fresh daily vegetables. Founded in 2004 as a tiny Robson Street spot, it became a Vancouver word-of-mouth institution before expanding to two Metro Vancouver locations. The Commercial Drive outpost sits in one of the city's most vibrant and cycle-friendly neighbourhoods, making it a natural stop on a cross-city ride.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 37m; stands (3 spaces) at 81m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the Commercial Drive location at 1605 Commercial Dr, Vancouver, with matching phone 604-563-8487. Vegetarian options are explicitly highlighted on the website ('Great options for vegetarians at all Babylon Cafe locations') with a dedicated Vegetarian Plate and Falafel options. Takeout is confirmed by the fast-food format and a customer review referencing 'getting in and out' without eating in; no evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or tech amenities.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag and the website locations page show different hours for the Commercial Drive location — operators may want to verify and update the OSM tag.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant on Commercial Drive with a confirmed web presence and matching contact details. A straightforward inclusion for cyclists seeking a quick Middle Eastern meal.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering service is offered for events. The business previously had up to 4 locations; currently confirmed at 2 (Commercial Drive and Denman Street).

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Great options for vegetarians at all Babylon Cafe locations'; menu includes Vegetarian Plate, Falafel Plate, Falafel Wrap, and Grilled Veggie Wrap

wow_evidence: became a Vancouver word-of-mouth institution before expanding to two Metro Vancouver locations
